Researcher caveat 3: The effective corpus sizes (350–391) are relatively small, which may limit the granularity and stability of discovered topics.
Researcher caveat 4: The minimum topic size of 5 means very small micro-topics (fewer than 5 documents) are merged or discarded, so rare but coherent conversations may not surface as distinct topics.
